Who We Are

iHost Solutions Ltd. is a North Vancouver-based property-services company supporting appliance installation, small repairs, cleaning coordination, and rental unit turnover. We serve Greater Vancouver and Victoria with an emphasis on agreed scopes, clear scheduling, and documented job completion.

Service Capabilities

Appliance Installation

Dishwasher replacements, washer/dryer installation, range hoods, OTR microwaves, and selected built-in appliances within permitted and insured scope.

Handyman & Minor Repairs

Drywall patches, shelving, assembly, TV mounting, minor carpentry, and property punch-list work.

Unit Turnover

Pre-handover repairs, touch-ups, fixture condition notes and completion documentation for property managers.

Cleaning & Property Care

Residential cleaning and commercial cleaning inquiries, with final work acceptance subject to crew capacity and confirmed insurance coverage.

Our Work-Order Process

We assess scope, access and site conditions before booking, confirm changes before additional work, document applicable installation checks and completion, and provide a clear contact for follow-up or escalation. Technician capacity and exact service areas are confirmed for each assignment.

Procurement & Partnership Enquiries

We welcome BC facility-management, property-management, retail installation and subcontracting enquiries, including a paid trial work order. Request the current official business licence, WorkSafeBC letter, insurance certificate and supporting credentials directly at info@ihost604.ca.
